{{Top|leg}}
'''''Sague''''' was a group of three [[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]]s employed to defend a Salvage platform called [[AZ 77 (Venzeiia 2)|''AZ 77'']]. The shuttles attempted to protect the platform and provide time for [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|transports]] ''[[Lin]]'', ''[[Ko]]'' and ''[[Kaar]]'' to escape. The Escort shuttles engaged [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] and were destroyed in the skirmish.
